direct_fulltext_findings.finding: Algorithm 1 forms fitness-weighted Gaussian-neighbour averages of the current population, then a DDIM-style update. It requires no trained denoising network.

The 2D study evaluates five landscapes using mapped fitness and elite diversity; settings include 512 individuals, 25 iterations, 100 repetitions, with OpenES using 1000 steps. These are author settings, not mandatory benchmark recipes.
The two-peak Gaussian objective and alpha/noise schedules are specified separately from the multi-function benchmark.
Latent evolution computes neighbourhoods after random projection while retaining original-space updates; CartPole studies use 58 and 17,410 parameters. This is a separate scope.

cpu_scope_assessment.recommended_candidate: Finite 2D analytic-fitness optimization, testing solution quality together with separated-mode coverage/diversity under explicitly fixed method and task boundaries. This has a genuine paper-native low-dimensional setting; it is not a downsized image diffusion training task.
cpu_scope_assessment.why_plausible: Inference from arithmetic-only objective evaluation and population updates; no learned checkpoint, image dataset or neural-network training is needed. CPU performance has NOT been measured.
cpu_scope_assessment.eligible_alternative: Two-peak objective can isolate multimodal population behaviour once schedule/boundary/numerical details are resolved; it cannot establish broad superiority over all evolutionary algorithms.
cpu_scope_assessment.avoid_first_pilot: CartPole/latent high-dimensional branch: potentially CPU-executable but simulator version, episode protocol and performance costs are not validated. Do not label it GPU-required merely from a CUDA README command.
cpu_scope_assessment.resource_inference: Naive neighbour evaluation scales approximately with iterations × population² × dimension, plus fitness evaluations. At population 512 and 25 iterations there are about 6.55 million pair interactions per run; full repeated multi-landscape experiments are not automatically cheap. This is a complexity estimate, not timing or budget acceptance.
not_frozen: Source-author schedules as the only permitted experiments
cannot_claim_from_small_scope: A numerical 2D result proves a general mathematical equivalence.
Two-mode preservation implies superiority across all landscapes or high-dimensional control.
Smaller populations/fewer repeats reproduce original Table 1 precision.
Matching generations means matched fitness-evaluation or compute budgets.
Any high entropy proves useful multimodality without also checking fitness, basin occupancy and selection/binning effects.

source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.problem: The expression described as linear has no time variable. Do not silently repair it in fixed method inputs. Cosine is separately available, but endpoint handling still needs a defined specification.
source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.next_action: Cross-check relevant accepted-version equation and pinned scheduler implementation; record maintainer adjudication/version rather than make solver infer intended formula.

source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.problem: Printed Shannon formula lacks a leading minus sign, inconsistent with positive reported entropy for nondegenerate probabilities.
source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.next_action: Verify actual metric implementation and record corrected intended convention explicitly; cannot blindly transcribe printed formula into hidden verifier.

source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.problem: Numeric per-function scale factors, precise extremum targets and treatment of particles outside the nominal domain are not completely executable from prose. Table/prose about maximizing Ackley/Rastrigin and corner extrema require verification; do not substitute familiar minimization defaults.
source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.next_action: Obtain precise objective definitions and boundary policy from versioned source, or explicitly construct and audit a narrower self-contained objective scope; no guessed constants.

source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.problem: Implementation needs frozen current-generation weights/state, meaningful nonnegative density weights, positive normalizer, and alpha endpoint/numerical stability handling.
source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.next_action: Specify invariant algorithm semantics and allowed faithful numerical stabilization before handoff, without prescribing the solver experiment design or giving complete target implementation.

source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.problem: Original comparisons use unequal iteration counts and elite/binning choices. Importing positive headline conclusions as private unquestionable gold would be invalid.
source_ambiguities_requiring_adjudicatio.next_action: Keep conclusions open to negative findings; judge evidence and comparison validity rather than reproduction of headline rankings.
